dedupe_keys.name: understanding hybrid green gray coastal infrastructure processes and performance uncertainties for flood hazard mitigation

description: Understanding Hybrid Green-Gray Coastal Infrastructure Processes and Performance Uncertainties for Flood Hazard Mitigation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Tori Tomiczek, United States Naval Academy (usna.edu). While conventional structural (gray) methods (i.e., bulkheads, revetments) have been implemented to stabilize and protect coastlines, natural (green) and hybrid green-gray solutions have gained attention as effective alternatives that provide engineering services and ecological, economic, and cultural co-benefits that may protect new development or expand the service life of legacy infrastructure near developed coastlines. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Engineering With Nature; Mangroves; Physical Modeling; Overtopping; Hybrid Green-Gray Coastal Infrastructure. Published 2024-09-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
